query: a smart sci-fi movie like Arrival

results.title: Ex Machina
results.explanation: A cerebral, slow-burn sci-fi film about AI consciousness and manipulation. It shares Arrival's thoughtful tone and big-ideas focus, and its brooding, twisty psychological tension suits this user's taste for Severance and Dark.

results.title: Moon
results.explanation: A melancholic, deliberately paced, intelligent sci-fi film about identity and isolation, very close to Arrival's emotional and philosophical register. Its quiet atmosphere and slow-burn reveals fit the user's cerebral, melancholic sci-fi leaning.

results.title: Annihilation
results.explanation: Meticulously paced, atmospheric sci-fi built on big ideas about mutation, grief, and first-contact-style mystery, with striking visuals and a thoughtful ending. Its brooding mood suits the user's liking for Blade Runner 2049 and Dark.

results.title: Mare of Easttown
results.explanation: A gritty, slow-burn murder mystery with a weathered detective and emotional depth, matching the layered-mystery taste of Broadchurch and Happy Valley, though set in Pennsylvania rather than Britain. It's the most popular and well-made crime drama here, but the American setting keeps it just short of a perfect British fit.

results.title: Unforgotten
results.explanation: A methodical, understated British police drama set on grey London streets, with the patient slow-burn tension, emotional depth, and layered cold-case mysteries this user loves from Broadchurch. Highly rated and a natural next watch.

results.title: The Responder
results.explanation: A gritty Liverpool-set crime drama with Martin Freeman as an exhausted, morally compromised cop, blending dark British humor with emotional depth. It's squarely gritty British crime and echoes the Slow Horses and Happy Valley sensibility.
